text:
maya: Quick FYI — I want to push the Console/UI patch (v1.4.2) at 10:30 PT today. Small change: asset manifest ordering + a tiny CSS fix. Can people watch the canary and do the quick smoke?

sam: I can be on watch. I'll trigger the canary and monitor Sentry + RUM for errors.

leo: I can do CDN priming after canary looks good. Prefer priming to a full purge if possible.

anya: What are the exact smoke checks we want so on-call knows what to validate?

maya: Good call. Smoke checklist: 
- Load console landing page (cold + warm) 
- Login flow (SSO + local) 
- Open a project, load the runs list, expand a run (kv cache test)
- Token refresh flow (15m + 1h)
- Quick a11y smoke on the header nav
- Verify no 500s in /api/* from browser logs

sam: Add: check token expiry related banner on console settings page. Also watch frontend error rate in dashboard (threshold: >0.5% new errors).

leo: On CDN: We'll do a prefix priming for /static/console/* first. If anything funky, fallback to invalidation for affected hashes only. I have a script: 

```
# fastly API example
curl -X POST \
  -H "Fastly-Key: $FASTLY_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://api.fastly.com/service/$FASTLY_SERVICE/purge/prefix/static/console/
```

If we need CloudFront invalidation for S3-backed assets: 
```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E1234ABC --paths "/static/console/*"
```

maya: Perfect. We'll do canary (5%) for 10 mins, smoke run, then 100% ramp if green. Rollback plan: revert to previous release tag and invalidate only newly uploaded assets if we see visual regressions.

frank: Can someone post the exact deploy command and canary target so I can run a dry-run in staging?

sam: Deploy command (from ci): 
```
CI_DEPLOY_ENV=production make deploy-console TAG=v1.4.2 CANARY_PERCENT=5
```
Canary target: canary slot "console-canary-02" (region us-west-2).

maya: Booking 30m on-call watch. @sam you'll trigger at T=0. @leo start priming at T+12m if no errors. @anya please coordinate smoke checklist and confirm passes.

anya: Will do. I'll post pass/fail thread snippets in here with times.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for console v1.4.2 -> console-canary-02 (5%)

sam: Canary up. Initial RUM load times look normal. No new Sentry errors in the first 5m.

leo: Starting CDN prefix prime now. Running the fastly prefix purge (non-blocking).

maya: Smoke: landing page cold load ✅, login ✅, runs list ✅, expand run ✅, token banner present — manual check OK.

anya: a11y header nav quick pass. No 500s in /api/* (browser logs).

sam: Watching metrics: error rate 0.12% (baseline 0.08%), retries within expected. Proceeding to ramp to 100%.

deploy-bot: Routing update: console target at 100% completed.

leo: CDN priming finished. I spot one stale asset hash for /static/console/main.8a1b2.js — issuing targeted invalidation now.

maya: Targeted invalidation done. Clearing local caches and re-testing visuals... all good.

frank: Thanks everyone. Noting deploy complete and ops checklist done. I'll file the release note for v1.4.2.

maya: Great team — thanks! :tada:
